facts.fact: Winter 用 gracious 反讽回敬她在绞刑场的挖苦
facts.anchor: He taunted her with the word she’d hurled at him during the hanging

facts.fact: 弟弟在手她才收敛：否则她会喷死亡威胁
facts.anchor: He knew if he didn’t have her brother locked in his cellar that she would’ve spewed death threats

facts.fact: 父亲多年追捕 RRH 未果，牺牲数十狼
facts.anchor: his father had attempted to catch Red Riding Hood. Spent countless resources and sacrificed dozens of wolves

facts.fact: 袭击外婆前 Winter 确认过她独居
facts.anchor: Sterling’s grandmother had lived alone—he’d made sure of it before assembling wolves to attack her

facts.fact: Winter 曾禁 Micah 变身三个月（作为伤 Sterling 的惩罚）
facts.anchor: Winter had punished him for it by banning him from shifting for three months

facts.fact: 地牢里的 Cyan 干净整洁、健康——姐姐照顾得好
facts.anchor: The boy was a skinny thing, though kempt and appeared healthy enough

facts.fact: Cyan 向 Winter 隐瞒姐姐杀狼，只说猎兔子松鼠
facts.anchor: “She goes hunting. Rabbits and squirrels,” he said in a tiny voice

facts.fact: Cyan 请 Winter 带纸：想给他折点东西
facts.anchor: “Will you bring a few sheets of paper? I would like to make you something.”

facts.fact: Winter 命令明早带两打人类囚犯
facts.anchor: “Bring two dozen human prisoners here at first light,”

facts.fact: 死亡游戏规则：她 vs 两打人类，唯一幸存者自由；她赢弟弟也放
facts.anchor: You against two dozen humans. The sole survivor earns their freedom

facts.fact: Micah 意图染指被拒——Winter 的狼本能护她独占
facts.anchor: “No.” Winter bristled when his wolf growled. She was his prisoner to do with as he pleased, no one else’s.
